source_note: gap fill 2026-10-13 (run e): Profit Before Tax, Income Tax and Net Profit FY2025 read from the audited FY2025 column of African and Overseas Enterprises Limited condensed consolidated results for the six months ended 31 December 2025. AON is the N ordinary share line of the same issuer as AOO and carries the same audited figures.
reconciliation_note: FY2026 bridges, all from the printed statement: Retail sales 704,800 less Cost of sales 326,230 equals Gross profit 378,570. The Revenue row follows this file existing convention and carries the printed Retail sales line; the top Revenue line in the filing is 954,480 and includes Other revenue of 249,680, which the panel has no label for, so Gross profit ties to the retail line only. Gross profit 378,570 plus Other revenue 249,680 less the printed Other expenses 561,097 less the impairment reversals on financial assets 4,349 less the net foreign exchange loss 6,972 equals the printed profit from operating activities of 55,832, stored as Operating Profit (EBIT); Operating expenses are therefore stored as 322,738 so that Gross profit less Operating expenses equals that same 55,832. Net finance costs are stored as 27,319, being the printed finance costs of 65,382 less the printed finance income of 38,063. Profit before tax 28,047 less Income tax 13,826 equals Profit for the year 14,221, of which 3,507 is attributable to owners of the parent and 10,714 to non-controlling interests; the Net Profit row stores the attributable figure, matching this file FY2025 column of 12,637. Earnings per share 29.34 cents basic, as printed. Note on the older columns: the FY2025 to FY2022 columns come from a secondary feed and their operating profit figures do not match the audited statements, the stored FY2025 operating profit being negative 107,188 where the audited statement prints a profit from operating activities of 74,031. Those columns are left as they stand and are flagged here rather than silently overwritten.
